"Create a high-quality 3D Myanmar Multiplayer Open World Farm Simulation Game.

Gameplay Style:

- Third-person open-world exploration with smooth character movement and free camera control.
- Play as a customizable male character wearing traditional Myanmar clothing.
- Explore a large seamless Myanmar countryside with traditional villages, wooden houses, rice fields, rivers, forests, mountains, monasteries and golden pagodas.
- Build and customize houses, farms and other buildings.
- Plant, water and harvest crops.
- Raise cows, buffaloes, chickens, ducks, horses and other animals.
- Fishing, cooking, crafting, trading and resource gathering.
- Interact with villagers, NPCs, shops and complete quests.
- Dynamic day/night cycle, weather and seasons.
- Own property, upgrade equipment and develop your village life.
- Online multiplayer with friends, cooperative farming, trading and shared exploration.
- Fully playable offline single-player mode.

Graphics @COMMENT_BODY@ Controls:
Premium stylized-realistic 3D graphics, beautiful natural lighting, detailed environments, realistic water, lush vegetation and smooth animations.

Mobile-friendly third-person controls with virtual joystick, camera control, action buttons, inventory, minimap, quests and professional RPG HUD.

Make it immersive, visually beautiful, highly interactive and optimized for Android.

Build a complete playable game, not just a prototype or visual demo. Choose the most suitable technologies yourself.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Build a polished, playable 3D Myanmar countryside farming game with exploration, farming, trading, quests, mobile controls, and offline single-player play.

## Requirements
- Third-person exploration, traditional Myanmar character and countryside, farming and animal life, crafting/trading/quests, dynamic time and weather, property building, and Android-friendly HUD/controls.
